entities.name: Transguild Promenade
entities.description: A renowned thoroughfare on Ravnica serving as neutral ground and travel route for all ten guilds, lined with arches and pillars engraved with guild insignias.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane of ten guilds on which the Promenade lies.

entities.name: Tenth District
entities.description: District of Ravnica through which the Promenade runs; Bolas's Citadel was erected in its plaza.

entities.name: Relov
entities.description: An Azorius arbiter who met Javy on the Promenade and was later turned into a statue by Vraska.

entities.name: Javy
entities.description: A Wojek investigator who warned Relov while secretly being the one working for Vraska to kill him.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker on whose behalf Javy worked, who turned Relov into a statue.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who paused at the Promenade's edge trying to solve the mystery of an erased memory of the Implicit Maze.

entities.name: Emmara Tandris
entities.description: Recipient of Jace's mental transfer of the Implicit Maze's map.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Announced the maze runners at the Promenade intersection and then declared himself the Izzet runner.

entities.name: Melek
entities.description: The chosen Izzet representative, blasted with lightning by Ral.

entities.name: Implicit Maze
entities.description: A guild race whose route included an intersection on the Promenade.

entities.name: Teyo Verada
entities.description: A shieldmage who first planeswalked into the middle of the Promenade, and later reunited with Rat there.

entities.name: Araithia Shokta
entities.description: Ravnican who noticed Teyo and helped him out of the way of carts.

entities.name: Rat
entities.description: A companion of Teyo who vanished after the war and was found at the Promenade again.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker said to have a plan so Teyo and Rat would not have to say goodbye.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder Dragon who erected Bolas's Citadel in the Tenth District Plaza.

entities.name: Bolas's Citadel
entities.description: Structure Bolas erected in the Tenth District Plaza.

events.summary: Azorius arbiter Relov meets Wojek investigator Javy on a Promenade bench; Javy warns him someone wants to kill him, not revealing it is her.
events.quote: Javy warned Relov that someone was out to kill him

events.summary: Jace pauses at the edge of the Promenade struggling to solve the mystery of the Implicit Maze memory he erased.
events.quote: Jace struggled to solve the mystery of a memory of the Implicit Maze that he had erased from his mind.

events.summary: The guilds gather at the Promenade intersection for the start of the Implicit Maze; Ral blasts Melek and announces himself as the Izzet runner.
events.quote: Ral quickly blasted him with lightning, dispersing his energy.

events.summary: Teyo Verada's first planeswalk lands him in the middle of the Promenade, where Araithia Shokta helps him out of the cart traffic.
events.quote: Teyo Verada had his first planeswalk

events.summary: After the war Teyo finds Rat again at the Promenade and they walk off together.
events.quote: Teyo and Rat walked off together, arm in arm.

relations.quote: a renowned thoroughfare on the plane of Ravnica

relations.note: Working on Vraska's behalf to kill Relov.
Later turned him into a statue.
relations.quote: who later turned Relov into a statue
